action.objective: Verify b5a4 (Bd3/Ba4 retreat) as the leading candidate after Black's Qd7; confirm no tactical refutation.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 2 (cutoff) gave b5a4 exact 301, PV [Ba4, Qg4]. Other candidates are shallower/bounded uppers. The bishop retreats to a safe diagonal and keeps pressure on c6/d7. Need single-candidate verification at full depth to check for tactical refutation; the d6 bishop and Qd7 could create threats.
